long_biography.plain_text:
JSM Group began as a subcontractor laying ducts and cable beneath roads. Stuart Wiltshire established it with John and Mark Scanlon, then led its expansion into the design and delivery of power and communications networks. The company gained direct contracting work and developed methods for installing and maintaining infrastructure with less disruption to existing services.

Wiltshire guided JSM through its first private-equity investment and a later change of majority investor. The business broadened its work in grid connections, fibre networks and data-centre infrastructure during his tenure. He subsequently handed over the chief executive role but continued to offer strategic guidance.
